summary: CRITICAL FINDING: AsyncStorage persistence feature is NOT implemented in /app/frontend/app/games/mafia.tsx. The file imports `AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage'` at line 10, but the module is NEVER referenced anywhere in the rest of the file. There is no `AsyncStorage.getItem` / `setItem` / `removeItem` call, no `hydrated` flag, no load `useEffect` and no save `useEffect`. Verified via grep (only line 10 contains the word 'AsyncStorage') and via live reproduction at 414x900 on the public preview URL: (1) opened Mafia → tapped mafia-start-button → added 6 Arabic names → all 6 player-row-{i} testIDs visible → BUT localStorage.getItem('mafia_game_state_v1') === NULL (never written). (2) page.reload() → app restarts at intro → tapped mafia-start-button → players phase shows 0 names (counter reads '0' / 'احفظ على الأقل 6 لاعبين'). All claimed persistence (names, phase, role counts, manual assignments, in-progress game state) is broken because the underlying read/write code does not exist. Other regression items are fine: home shows 3 game cards (دومينو/كارت/مافيا), the new clear-all-names-btn (سمح الكل) renders, players-next-btn renders. Cannot test PERSIST PHASE / PERSIST ROLE COUNTS / END-GAME RESTART preservation / clear-all confirm-and-persist scenarios because they all depend on the missing save/load layer. Sniper + cards + domino regressions were fully validated in iter_7/iter_8 and code there is unchanged.

integration_issues.flow: AsyncStorage persistence (names / phase / role counts / manual assigns / in-progress game state)
integration_issues.issue: Feature completely unimplemented. AsyncStorage imported at mafia.tsx:10 but never used. No setItem/getItem/hydrated flag/useEffect for load or save exists in the file. localStorage['mafia_game_state_v1'] stays NULL after adding 6 names; page.reload() loses 100% of state.

action_items: Implement the AsyncStorage persistence layer in mafia.tsx that the PRD describes:

1. Add a `hydrated` boolean state (default false) and a load useEffect that runs once on mount: `await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)`, JSON.parse, and apply each saved field via setPlayerNames / setRoleCounts / setDistribution / setManualAssign / setPhase / setPlayers / setRevealIndex / setRevealShown / setRound / setNightActions (also nightActionsRef.current) / setLastDoctorProtect / setDetectiveResult / setNightSummary / setProtectedThisNight / setVoteVoterIndex / setVoteTally / setEliminatedPlayer / setPendingBomberPull / setWinner. After applying, setHydrated(true). Wrap in try/catch.

2. Add a save useEffect with dependency array containing all the above pieces of state; bail out if `!hydrated`. Body: `AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({playerNames, roleCounts, distribution, manualAssign, phase, players, revealIndex, revealShown, round, nightActions, lastDoctorProtect, detectiveResult, nightSummary, protectedThisNight, voteVoterIndex, voteTally, eliminatedPlayer, pendingBomberPull, winner}))`.
3. Update the clear-names-btn confirm callback so the cleared array gets written (the save useEffect will do this automatically once #2 lands).

4. Confirm restartGame() (line 630) intentionally KEEPS playerNames as the PRD says (currently it RESETS playerNames to [] at line 632 — this contradicts the requested 'end-game restart should keep player names'). Either remove `setPlayerNames([])` from restartGame, or rename current behaviour to fullResetGame and bind `end-restart` to a new partial-reset that preserves names.
5. Add a `fullResetGame()` (not exposed in UI per PRD) that clears AsyncStorage via `AsyncStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY)` and resets everything including names.

Re-test after implementation: (a) add 6 names → reload → names should still appear in players phase. (b) set role counts → reload → counts preserved. (c) reach reveal index 3 → reload → restart at reveal index 3 with same player. (d) end-restart keeps names but resets counts/phase to roleCounts. (e) clear-names-btn confirm clears localStorage entry to empty array.
critical_code_review_comments: mafia.tsx:10 imports AsyncStorage but the entire file never uses it — TypeScript / lint would not catch this because ESLint's no-unused-vars is typically off for default imports in TSX. Recommend adding a unit smoke check or eslint rule to flag unused imports in mission-critical paths.

restartGame() at line 630-652 currently resets playerNames to [] (line 632). The PRD/agent_to_agent_context_note states the desired behaviour is to PRESERVE playerNames on end-restart so users can replay with same group. Current code does the opposite. Main agent must update.
restartGame() also does not interact with AsyncStorage at all, so once persistence is added it must explicitly persist the partial-reset (or the save useEffect will catch it).

exitToHome() (line 654) does NOT clear AsyncStorage by design (good — users can resume), but that means PERSIST PHASE only works if the save useEffect runs before router.back(). Verify by reading state from storage at the very last save tick before unmount. Consider awaiting AsyncStorage.setItem in exitToHome before router.back() to guarantee write happens.
mafia.tsx is 2069 lines — recommend extracting persistence into /app/frontend/hooks/useMafiaPersistence.ts for testability.
Per fix-scope, I did NOT implement the persistence (this is a multi-screen feature with many state pieces — main-agent territory, not selector/typo territory).

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent implements the load/save useEffects, retest the following at viewport 414x900 on https://mobile-game-design-3.preview.emergentagent.com (NOTE: the URL in the review_request differs from frontend/.env — use the env URL): (1) Add 6 names → page.evaluate localStorage.getItem('mafia_game_state_v1') should be a non-null JSON containing playerNames array of length 6. (2) page.reload() → tap mafia-start-button → players phase should already show all 6 player-row-{i}. (3) Set role counts citizen=2/doctor=1/detective=1/mafia_leader=1/silencer_mafia=1 → exit via mafia-back (confirm) → re-enter Mafia → tap mafia-start-button → players-next-btn → role counts phase should show same counts. (4) Reach reveal index 3 → reload → should land back on reveal at index 3 with the same player. (5) Complete a quick game (use 6-player setup with any winning condition) → tap end-restart → playerNames should remain populated, roleCounts/phase/players/round should be reset. (6) On players phase, tap clear-names-btn (testID present) → confirm → all rows gone AND localStorage value contains playerNames:[].
rca_of_issue: RCA: The PRD/handoff note claims AsyncStorage persistence was added, but inspection of /app/frontend/app/games/mafia.tsx via `grep -n 'AsyncStorage\|setItem\|getItem\|hydrat' mafia.tsx` returns ONLY line 10 (the import). No load useEffect, no save useEffect, no hydrated flag, no STORAGE_KEY usage besides the constant declaration at line 12. Live test confirmed: localStorage stays NULL after state mutations and reload yields a fresh app at intro phase. CONCLUSION: implementation was either not committed or only the import + STORAGE_KEY constant were stubbed without the body. MITIGATION: see action_items for the exact useEffect skeletons needed.
